system.requirement: Communication and Constitution 1 or higher You take your fun seriously.

degree0.desc: You can drink other people under the table. You gain +1 to Constitution (Tolerance) tests.

degree1.desc: You are intimate with the party crowd. Choose one of the following focuses: Communication (Seduction) or Perception (Empathy). If you fail a test with your chosen focus, you can re-roll it, but you must keep the result of the second roll.

degree2.desc: When you’re having a good time, (you think) you’re invincible! Choose one of the following social stunts: Flirt or Benefit of the Doubt. You can perform that stunt for 1 SP less than its normal cost.
